name: Email to specified leads in CRM (MASTER)

mapper.formula:
AND(
  {Opted-In?}=FALSE(),
  {Lead Warmth}!="Unsubscribed",
  {Lead Warmth}!="Employee",
  {Lead Warmth}!="Client",
  {Email}!=BLANK(),
  FIND("@", {Email})>0,
  {Contact Type}!="Supplier",
  OR(
    {Email Touch Point}="",
    FIND("Recorded copy of 'The Architect's Dilemma' CPD Event", {Email Touch Point})=0
  )
)

filter.name: Ensures only one email sent per lead

conditions.b: Recorded copy of 'The Architect's Dilemma' CPD Event

mapper.html:
Dear {{10.`First Name`}},

I hope you have been well and business is booming for you!

Following Carma UK Constructions recent event, "The Architect's Dilemma", I'd like to share a link to the recording for you and your team to watch.

This CPD featured professionals from Q Two Consulting and Beyond Carbon, and covered key topics including:

  • The realities of Passivhaus design
  • Minimizing embodied carbon
  • Designing for resilience against overheating
  • Navigating JCT pitfalls and RIBA frameworks

YouTube link: The Architect's Dilemma Episode 01

If you don't feel comfortable clicking the link, you can also find it on YouTube under that title.

We are now planning our next CPD event on the 3rd of November, which will take place in Oxford. This session will focus on two critical topics for the modern architect:

Preventing water ingress: Learn how to leverage sensors and AI to protect your projects from water damage and associated costs.
Building regulations & fire safety: Get an overview of key legislation, including the Building Safety Act 2022, and understand the latest fire safety guidance.

This event will feature industry professionals from ConstruktCLT, OWL Building Control Solutions Ltd, and Tector.

If you are interested in attending, please let me know and I can send you a link to the event!
Look forward to hearing from you and hope you find the recording valuable.

Have a good day.

Warm regards,
Paul Sellers
CEO, Carma UK Construction

ps@carmaukconstruction.co.uk
+44 7719 338653
